dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures feature irregular, jagged, high-intensity light perimeters; one large 'C' on the left flank and a distinct closed 'O' near the dorsal midline show sharp gradient transitions from dark exterior to light boundary and back to dark interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity clusters lacking internal gradients; localized primarily as small, scattered asymmetrical specks along the upper dorsal ridge and toward the posterior transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the prominent left-flank 'C' structure, the dorsal-central 'O' ring, and the dense cluster on the right-lateral side form an obtuse scalene triangle across the dorsal-lateral curvature.
